value.display: Black British, with family roots in Nigeria

preferences.summary: Use plain language and avoid unexplained medical terminology.
preferences.details: Allow time to process information and check understanding without rushing.

accessibilityNeeds.summary: Requires reasonable adjustments for a mild to moderate learning disability.
accessibilityNeeds.details: May become anxious or overwhelmed by complex written information and has a learning disability healthcare passport.

relationships.name: Folake Omolade
relationships.notes: Main source of emotional and practical support, including help with appointments, forms and written information.

background.summary: Lives with his older sister Folake.
Works part-time in a charity shop with support and values the structure and independence.
Finds quiet prayer comforting when worried and prefers this to be approached sensitively.

problems.details: Diagnosed five months before the source scenario.
Described as mild to moderate in the source material.

facts.summary: Type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosed five months before the source scenario.

catalogue.synopsis: A young adult with type 2 diabetes and a learning disability who values independence and benefits from accessible communication.
